title: DeckMate
description: Started as a website with a deck calculator feeding Zoho CRM. Rebuilt into a full deck quoting app for carpenters, on the web and iPhone.
features: Drag-to-draw deck plans: L-shapes, angles, steps, pergolas and pools
Framing with span checks, a 3D build and a cut list packed into stock lengths
Live pricing from real trade rates, with markup and margin sliders
Branded PDF quotes emailed to the client from the app

title: Tradeflow
description: A bespoke business management platform designed to streamline supplier relationships, quoting, and procurement.
features: Advanced supplier and price list management
Automated quote and purchase order generation
